# Creatr365

> A Creative House for the Future of Live Commerce.
> Be a Creator, Not a Consumer.

Creatr365 develops professional live-commerce hosts through a structured,
multi-level program built on psychology, data, and communication — not a
casual live-selling tips course. Based in Bangkok, Thailand; courses are
delivered online and onsite.

## What we do

- Structured host-development program across five courses (free entry course
  through advanced onsite masterclasses), built on the PPACT framework:
  Presence, Psychology, Authority, Communication, Trust
- A completion record (not a professional certification) issued per course
  on finishing all lessons and the end-of-course assessment
- A diagnostic assessment that maps a learner's starting skill profile

## Where we work

Bangkok, Thailand. Courses are delivered online (video-on-demand) and, for
the onsite masterclasses, in person — course pages state the format for
each course individually.
